title: Velorum
subtitle: Saint of the Endless Hour
text: An ascetic of a secluded order that held hunger, warmth, fatigue and want to be the root of all suffering. As a hemomancer, Velorum learned to slow his heart and cool his blood until he could sit for weeks without food, sleep or fire, and he took that for the perfection of the body. Followers came, and he stilled them too: cold, motionless, unaging. Their minds stayed awake in the dark. Some begged to be let go. He called it the last resistance of an imperfect mind, and began stilling people who had never asked. When the rest of his order moved against him, he stopped the blood of everyone inside the monastery walls. Congeatio holds the body still, and Tenebris shuts out every sense, until a single hour seems to have no end. He has stayed lucid through all of it, seated among his congregation, and counts every one of them a success. Struck down, he settles back into dormancy. He does not count that as a loss.
